Remark
[Time-directedness of the strong maximum principle] ↗ thm:strong-maximum-principle-heat-equation 1. ch2:2.3.3-rem-4\group Maximum Principles

An interior maximum at time $t_0$ forces constancy only at times not exceeding $t_0$; later boundary data may change the solution.
